description: A map of strings and an object whose attribute types don't unify with each other unify to the map
notes: The spec says map and object types unify by preferring the object type, so the selected object would stay {a = 1, b = true}. hashicorp/hcl can't unify the object's number and bool to one map element type (unifyObjectsAsMaps in cty/convert/unify.go), so it ranks the two types, putting the map first (compareTypes in cty/convert/compare_types.go), and converts each attribute to a string.
